C0151.title: Shanghai Police Dismantle 'Account Factory': Illegally Obtained Citizen Data Used to Register and 'Fatten' Accounts for Sale
C0151.summary: In April 2026, the Shanghai Municipal Public Security Bureau disclosed a case of illegally obtaining computer information system data. The Xuhui District public security cyber unit dismantled a criminal gang specialized in manufacturing, farming, and selling accounts. Ringleader Zhang, together with Guo, Liang, and others, illegally obtained over 10,000 citizens real-name ID records, used an all-purpose registration machine for unattended bulk registration of popular game accounts, increased account trading value through account farming, and sold the accounts at premium prices after they were fattened, involving over 2 million yuan.
